title: Bar Model: Comparison (Multiples)
question: Ali has 3 times as many marbles as Ben. Together they have 120 marbles. How many marbles does Ali have?

timeline.say: Ali has 3 times as many marbles as Ben. Together they have 120 marbles. How many marbles does Ali have?
First, let's find the key information. Ali has 3 times as many as Ben.
Let's draw Ben's bar first. Ben has 1 unit.
Ali has 3 times as many, so Ali's bar is 3 of the same units.
Let's mark the units, so we can see they are all equal.
We want to find Ali's marbles, so we put a question mark here.
Pause and think. How many units are there altogether?
Count the units. 1 plus 3 makes 4 units.
So 1 unit is 120 divided by 4, which is 30.
So, Ali has 90 marbles. Well done!
